## Community Conversations: Cryptomining

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## The Problem

-   Proposed cryptocurrency mining facility
-   Potential issues
-   Some citizens are concerned
-   Even Starkville city staff recommend denial of request as it is presented

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## A Plan / Not “The” Plan 

1.  Community members discuss the issue
    -  this meeting
    -  online discourse prior and after
2.  Attendance at the Planning and Zoning Commission meeting
    -  Tomorrow (8/11), 5:30pm at City hall
    -  A few of us plan to give a longer broken up speech
    -  Anyone that wants to talk will hopefully have time (tips to follow)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## A Plan / Not “The” Plan (cont'd) {.smaller}

3.  Attendance at the next Board of Aldermen meeting where it will be discussed
    -  P&Z Commission recommendation –\> Board of Aldermen the following week (8/18)
    -  We will know by the Friday before (8/14) if on the agenda
    -  If not that week, may be next month.
    -  I really don't know.
    -  Could it be dismissed at the next work session for consent items at the next BoA meeting???
4.  Vigilance - this or similar requests could be made in the future
    -  The same company may update their request with actual data to back up claims
    -  Maybe it will be acceptable at that point...
    -  But maybe not

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Structure of the P&Z Meeting {.smaller}

1.  Normal starting things: Intro, Pledge of Allegiance & Moment of Silence, Roll Call, consideration of agenda, approval of minutes of previous meeting
2.  Citizen Comments
    -  Since there is an actual item on the agenda for the crypto mining facility, this is not where we should speak
3.  New business
    -  There are 3 items to discuss, A, B, an C; the crypto mine is B
    -  Due to how many people are present to discuss the crypto mine, they may move it up in the order.
    -  Just pay attention to when people are talking about the data center!

- Note: Flexible / subject to change slightly!

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Guidelines for Speeches/Speaking

-   Writing
-   Delivery
-   Flexibility

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Writing

-   Write out your thoughts ahead of time
    -   Maybe get feedback from peers?
-   Share why you care and what you want
-   Grounded in facts, not opinions
-   Don't tell jokes
-   Be respectful; don't be accusatory
-   Your audience is the officials in front of you, not the community behind you
-   Be brief (ideally \<2-3 minutes, especially if speaking on behalf of yourself)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Delivery

-   Dress presentably
-   Calm and measured, not overly emotional or “hysterical”
-   Practice a few times; time yourself
-   I don't think we have time to pass out any visual aids (or use the presentation media)
-   Breathe

## Flexibility

-   Realize that we may not all get to speak, depending on what rules are enforced
-   The numbers and overall sentiment may mean more than the specific arguments made, but we should still try to be coherent and respectful

------------------------------------------------------------------------
